description: This file is a shell script that contains functions and configurations for managing wireless interfaces, especially with the mac80211 driver in OpenWrt. It includes setup routines for different wireless modes (access point, station, mesh, monitor), capability configurations, and interaction with external tools like hostapd and wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: init_wireless_driver
methods.description: Initializes the wireless driver setup by calling the driver-specific setup routine.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_device_config
methods.description: Adds common device-specific configurations for hostapd.

methods.name: config_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string configuration parameter.

methods.name: config_add_int
methods.description: Adds an integer configuration parameter.

methods.name: config_add_boolean
methods.description: Adds a boolean configuration parameter.

methods.name: config_add_array
methods.description: Adds an array configuration parameter.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_bss_config
methods.description: Adds common BSS configuration settings for hostapd.

methods.name: json_select
methods.description: Selects a JSON context for further operations.

methods.name: json_get_vars
methods.description: Retrieves multiple variables from the current JSON context.

methods.name: json_get_values
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values from JSON arrays.

methods.name: json_get_var
methods.description: Retrieves a single variable from JSON.

methods.name: json_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string to JSON.

methods.name: json_add_object
methods.description: Creates a new JSON object.

methods.name: json_close_object
methods.description: Closes a JSON object.

methods.name: json_set_namespace
methods.description: Sets the JSON namespace context.

methods.name: wireless_setup_vif_failed
methods.description: Handles failure in setting up a wireless virtual interface.

methods.name: wireless_add_process
methods.description: Adds a process (such as wpa_supplicant or hostapd) to the wireless configuration.

methods.name: json_dump
methods.description: Dumps current JSON structure to string.

methods.name: ubus
methods.description: Interacts with ubus system for communication with OpenWrt services.

methods.description: Interface for iw commands for wireless tools.

methods.description: Interface for iwinfo commands.

methods.name: sleep

methods.description: Loads JSON data from a file.

methods.name: json_for_each_item
methods.description: Iterates over items in a JSON array.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Finds the physical wireless interface based on various parameters.

methods.name: list_phy_interfaces
methods.description: Lists network interfaces associated with a physical wireless device.
